recipe.visualDefinition: A bright, outdoor portrait of two men standing in front of vintage vehicles under a clear blue sky. The scene is characterized by warm sunlight, a low-angle perspective, and a combination of ornate, western-style display lettering and distressed sans-serif subtext.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject-to-background: High contrast between the dark clothing and the bright, airy sky.
Typography-to-subject: The large display text is centered between the two figures, creating a visual bridge.
Color-to-mood: Warm sun flares and red vehicle accents contrast with the cool blue sky to evoke a nostalgic, summer feel.
Perspective: A low-angle shot that makes the subjects appear taller and more heroic.
coreInvariants: Bright, natural daylight with visible lens flare
Outdoor setting featuring vintage American vehicles
Two male subjects in casual, rugged attire (denim, leather, western shirts)
Stacked, centered typography with distinct stylistic hierarchies

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two men positioned at the left and right thirds of the frame, shown from the waist up, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, ornate display text centered in the upper half of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the central logo-like text, moves down to the subjects' faces, and follows the diagonal line of the vehicle to the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open sky at the top and sides provides breathing room for the complex typography.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm golden sunlight and lens flare highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red from the vehicle body in the lower half.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value in the sky, high saturation in the red vehicle, and deep shadows in the clothing for a punchy, commercial look.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or synthetic colors; stick to natural earth tones, denim blues, and sun-bleached highlights.

letterConstructionRules: Display text features heavy slab serifs with internal decorative scrollwork and drop shadows.
Initial letters are significantly larger and more ornate than the rest of the word.
Secondary text uses a heavy, condensed sans-serif with a distressed, stamped texture.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Elongated descenders on initial capital letters that wrap around subsequent characters.
Internal white-line detailing within the black letterforms.

composition.relationshipToImage: Floating in the sky negative space

composition.overlap: Overlays the vehicle and subject's leg

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of ornate, historical decorative type with modern, rugged industrial type.

preserve: The ornate western aesthetic of the top text
The distressed texture of the bottom text
avoid: Clean, modern geometric sans-serifs for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy western slab-serif decorative feel.
Matches the condensed, heavy weight of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle outdoor shot of two men in their 30s with short hair, wearing rugged western shirts and denim, standing in front of a red vintage truck and a blue vehicle. Bright blue sky background with a warm golden lens flare coming from the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large three-line stacked title in the upper center using a decorative black western font with white outlines. Add a single line of white distressed condensed sans-serif text at the bottom, slightly arced.

verificationChecks: Is the top text ornate and western-inspired?
Is there a visible lens flare effect?
Are the subjects wearing rugged, casual clothing?
Is the bottom text distressed and condensed?

adjustableVariables: Degree of distressing on the bottom text
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subjects

avoid: Mismatched lighting between subjects and environment

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is legible against the sky and foreground.
Ensure the lens flare does not obscure the subjects' faces.
Verify the perspective is consistently low-angle.
Confirm the color palette remains grounded in blues, reds, and golds.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a low-angle outdoor portrait of rugged subjects with a high-contrast sky, then layer ornate western-style display type in the negative space and distressed industrial type in the foreground.
